notes: Year is corrupt ('minarituśra', possibly a garbled chronogram) and the month is lost in a lacuna; era NS is inferred only from Newari script, saṃvat, a -malla king and Patan, so no CE approximation given. The king's name is lost except '-lladeva' (a Malla king). The owner's name is broken off after 'Jaya'; the phrase '(pusta)ko yaṃ' ('this is the book of ...') marks him as owner, and the first-person 'mayā kaṣṭena likhitaḥ' may mean he is also the scribe, but the scribe is not named separately. 'jeṣṭapramūla' is read as Jyeṣṭhā→Mūla nakṣatra by analogy with 'ekādaśī-pra-dvādaśī'; it could alternatively mean month Jyeṣṭha + Mūla nakṣatra. 'śrāniglaka' is an unidentified locality (ṭol?) in Patan; 'vūvahāra' = Bu-bāhā. No catalogue fields given to compare.
